# AudioCategory

[iOS](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.iOS` · enum

```csharp
public enum AudioCategory
```

How a game's audio sits with other apps' and the silent switch.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="ambient"></a>`Ambient` | Mixes with other apps, so the player's own music keeps playing, and respects the silent switch: the usual choice for a casual game. |
| <a name="soloambient"></a>`SoloAmbient` | Silences other apps' audio, and respects the silent switch. |
| <a name="playback"></a>`Playback` | Silences other apps' audio and plays through the silent switch: for a game whose audio is the point of it. |
